- One-time equity refresh (RSU) to bridge current grant -> target 25% of target OTE value.
- Mid-cycle cash top-up (pro-rated base increase + one-time spot bonus) to bring first-year realized comp within 5% of peer cohort.

Timeline: need approvals by 5/22 to ensure offer/relocation paperwork starts and payroll can process the one-time payment in June.

Please advise on the appropriate approval route and whether Finance needs additional language for the spot payment. Happy to hop on a 20m sync if easier.

Thanks,

- Current base (London par): £120,000 (~$150,000) -> proposed US base: $185,000 (pro-rated on promotion effective 6/1; i.e., movement in base goes into payroll starting 6/15 payroll cycle).

- One-time RSU bridge: $60,000 target value (time-vested over 2 years with 6-month cliff on 50% and remainder monthly thereafter) — labelled as one-time refresh to align current grant with Principal target.

We prefer to avoid recurring base bumps (unless comp committee insists), so please flag if that complicates approvals. Attached: Promotion_Memo_Claire.pdf and revised Salary_Adjustment_Form.pdf.

If you need a short note for Finance to justify the spot payout (tax/timing), I'll provide one. Otherwise we need sign-off to meet relocation vendor cutoffs.
